about: The map from FTF's functional areas to the tests that cover them, and the record of what has been verified where.
tools/test-plan.ps1 reads it to choose the tests for a change; docs/testing.md says how to use it and how to update the record.
paths: repo-relative globs (* within a folder, ** across folders). A file may belong to several areas.
shared: changing a file of a shared area runs the full unit suite (its unitTests is empty for that reason). A changed file in no area counts as shared too.

unitTests: dotnet test --filter clauses; joined with |, they select the test classes that cover the area. AreaMapTests checks they name real test classes and include every test that reaches the area's code.
civil3d: the deploy/smoke-test.ps1 sections that check the area in Civil 3D (the smoke test always runs them all). civil3dManual: Civil 3D runners run by hand at a milestone.
verified: unit / civil3d / installer record the commit, date and place each kind of check last passed; null means never verified. Never record a check that did not pass in full.

noTests.why: Documentation and old checkpoints: no test reads them. A file that is also in an area's paths (docs/ribbon.md, tests/LiveSmoke/fixtures/README.md) counts for that area instead.

alwaysRunWhy: Cheap repository-wide checks (namespace lint, compile-check coverage, no personal paths or real cases in tests, and AreaMapTests, which holds this map to the code): they run with every change that is not documentation only.

civil3dSections.main: the loaded DLL is this build, FTFVERSION, FTFCONTOUR on a seeded surface (ContourTestHarness)
civil3dSections.identity: source points read as Civil 3D stores them, FTFLINES naming lines from their shots, FTFREVIEWCHECK reading linework coding (IdentityTestHarness)
civil3dSections.accountability: FTFRUN Standard, the point ledger and linework continuity, -FTFREVIEW approvals, decisions that reopen, FTFQC Complete (AccountabilityTestHarness)
civil3dSections.style: FTFLABELS and FTFRESTYLE Preview / Apply against the office's annotation styles (StyleTestHarness)

installerTests.deploy/test-release.ps1: packages the real build and installs it into a scratch profile (Windows only; UPDATEFTF runs it)
installerTests.deploy/test-installer.ps1: the staff installer and publishing against synthetic releases, in scratch folders (any PowerShell)
